name: Hardware Reference
design_notes: Bought-part stand-ins (no vendor STEP supplied), posed at s1 in the shared lift/ world frame, for rendering and check_fit only: HIWIN MGN9 rails (9 x 6.5, 160 long) and MGN9C blocks (20 x 28.9, H 10, H1 2), NEMA17 (42.3 sq x 40), GT3 20T 10mm pulleys/idlers (OD 18.34, flange 24) and the three toothed belt clamp plates. Not for manufacture.

features.intent: stage1 MGN9 rails on the base front face
stage2 MGN9 rails on the stage1 front face
stage1 MGN9C blocks (wrap the rail; top face at x_c1)
NEMA17 body behind the base, face against the base back
NEMA17 22mm pilot boss, sits in the base bore
5mm motor shaft, 24mm long from the motor face
GT3 20T 10mm motor pulley (hub toward motor); copy at idler_z is the top idler + spacer
top drive idler on the slotted base mount
GT3 20T 10mm flanged idler + washer on an M5 shoulder bolt into stage1's -Y edge (bottom)
toothed clamp plate pinning the drive belt's inner strand to stage1's jaw
toothed clamp plate holding both ends of the cascade belt to the base jaw
toothed clamp plate pinning the cascade loop's front strand to stage2's jaw
